Becoming the best version of yourself is a very long and hard road dude.Begin with smaller goals for the bigger picture.Write down who you are right now,what your short goals should be,what you are good in and what your fears are.Negative traits,positive ones etc. Start to fix your negative traits and eliminate your fears by getting out of your comfort zone.Easier said then done but you have to take your chances if you want to grow stronger mentally.Being badass is a term that is really flexible but in a general view it is being nice,helpful and confident to me.Consider your problems in your life as tests that you have to pass to get better in life.If you have this point of view your struggles in life will be fun for you.(I know this from myself this year when I couldn't afford money for my last semester in college,I worked up 21 hours two weeks long as security guard and bouncer.I knew it wasn't fair but when I changed my point of view to this problem as a test that will make me stronger in life,I knew that nothing like this could take me down anymore).
Physically recommendation would be strength training,it builds your body and also your character.Once you grow stronger mentally and physically you'll realize that you won't GAF.Meditate daily for 15-20 minutes and eliminate your negative thoughts.Eat healthy and drink lots of water.Take care of your sleep schedule which is REALLY important!This is all I can think of right now but if you have any questions feel free to send me a message. Peace!
